description:
Perfect on gravel. Craving asphalt? Just swap the tires and enjoy the ride—it’s equally at home on the road. Our advice: buy two wheelsets, one with gravel tires and one with 30 mm road tires, so you’re always ready for either terrain.One bike, many souls, always true to Carrera Racing DNA. With its 900 g frame, Eravel is one of the lightest gravel frames on the market. Gravel designed with aerodynamic performance in mind, for riders who always want to push harder. Speed is in our racing DNA. Speed is in our racing DNA.

Carrera Eravel claimed the 2026 Italian Elite Gravel Championship with Filippo Agostinacchio (Team Biesse Carrera Premac), proving itself as a bike built to compete at the highest level. A victory that reflects Eravel’s performance, reliability and racing DNA.

Every Eravel colorway is created with a precise purpose. No palettes, no trends—just distinct personalities, each with its own character and ideal terrain. Choose the one that reflects yours.

Five standard colorways are just the starting point, never the destination. Colors, finishes and graphic details: together we’ll create an Eravel that carries only your name.

Crafted from aerospace-grade graphite fiber and vacuum molding free from structural imperfections, Eravel Pro eliminates turbulence, removes every unnecessary gram and transforms every surge of power into pure acceleration.

Integrated carbon handlebar designed to reduce clutter and improve aerodynamic efficiency. Available in multiple configurations to match your riding position and customizable in color to make it truly yours.

The frame profiles are the result of dedicated aerodynamic research: less drag, higher sustained speed. The same aerodynamic philosophy behind the Erakle Pro, now brought to gravel.

Up to 45 mm tire clearance: fit gravel tires for off-road adventures or road tires when it’s time to fly on asphalt.

Hidden seatpost clamp: less aerodynamic drag, cleaner frame lines.

Dropped seatstays provide the perfect balance between responsiveness and comfort.

86.5 × 41 PressFit bottom bracket with asymmetric design: maximum drivetrain stiffness and maximum pedaling efficiency.

From XS to XL, the Eravel monocoque frame is engineered to provide every rider with the same balance of aerodynamics and power transfer. If you already know your bike fit measurements, use the Stack and Reach values to identify your ideal size.
